actuator.gap_pos_note: = blowout_pos - air_gap. Armed IN AIR before descending.
actuator.post_asp_backoff_note: extra retract in air after leaving the water, anti-drip
actuator.stroke_margin_note: keep POS at least this far off the POS=0 hard stop

calibration.note: Store coefficients ONLY. Displacements are computed at runtime. No mm value is ever typed into a protocol script.

prewet.asp_pos_note: = blowout_pos - displacement_mm, measured from BOTTOMED, not from gap_pos

tube_rack_0p65_5x10.note: was marked <-- TUNE in the source and was never tuned

tiprack_300_96.note: pick=59.0 comes from the direct rack measurement and supersedes the old Z_TIP_PICK=57.5 in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py. Confirm 57.5 was not a different tip type.

sbs_96_wellplate.note: Measured 2026-09-08 with a 300 uL tip fitted. 'work' 53.5 is the dispense depth, about halfway down a well. 'bottom' 60.8 is the well floor - a CRASH LIMIT the machine must never reach, not somewhere to aim; the simulator fails any move deeper than it. Dispensing therefore sits 7.3 mm above the floor. Note 53.5 is 0.5 mm deeper than the raised-edge limit of 53.0, which is fine inside a location - the checks forbid crossing a location boundary at that depth, not being there.

tube_rack_1p5.note: 'work' and 'bottom' are still UNMEASURED. 'work' is the dispense and aspirate depth in a 1.5 mL tube; 'bottom' is the tube floor, a crash limit. 'mix' 45.0 is measured. Effector.z_for raises naming a null field, so protocols/centrifuge_test.py still refuses until 'work' is supplied.
tube_rack_1p5.mix_note: Measured 2026-09-08 with a 300 uL tip fitted. The depth Machine.mix cycles the plunger at. Deliberately a separate number from 'work' (dispense) and 'bottom' (crash limit).
